# Security policy

## Supported scope

Security fixes target the latest revision of the current self-hosted
`DRY_RUN` product. Private exchange credentials, Demo order submission, live
trading, withdrawals, transfers, leverage and derivatives are not supported
capabilities.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Use the repository's [private security advisory
form](https://github.com/kostia7alania/buy-crypto-dip-bot/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Include the affected revision, impact, minimal safe reproduction and suggested
mitigation. Replace real tokens, cookies, Telegram presentations, database URLs,
orders, portfolios and other personal or financial information with synthetic
values.

This community repository does not promise a response or remediation SLA. A
future hosted product requires a named security contact, severity/response
targets, on-call coverage and incident-communication policy before launch.
